questions.question:
Spot the error in the given sentence and select the correct sentence from the options given.

When it was time to chose between staying or leaving the country, she choose to stay back.

options.text: When it was time to choose between staying or leaving the country, she chose to stay back.
When it was time to chose between staying or leaving the country, she chose to stay back.
When it was time to choice between staying or leaving the country, she choose to stay back.
When it was time to have chose between staying or leaving the country, she chose to stay back.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"When it was time to choose between staying or leaving the country, she chose to stay back."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here let's see the correct sentence formation:

__
 
• When it was time to choose between staying or leaving the country, she ***chose*** to stay back.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Here we will the difference between the two words:

 
• **Choose* (used in present tense) *-** to select freely and after consideration

 
 
• ***Eg.*** He *choose h*is career as a Doctor.
 
 
 
• ** Chose *(used in past tense)* -** to decide on especially by vote
 
 
• ***Eg.*** She* chose* her father over him.

• 
 
**Direct speech** is a report of the exact words used by a speaker or writer. Contrast with indirect speech. Also called direct discourse.

• 
 
“So if I win at that table, I’ll go on to the World Series,” said the mom I know as some kind of government contractor.
